rounding.diff_rule: hw differs from round-half-even exactly when acc mod 65536 == 16384 (exact +half at even multiple)

saturation.note_min_samples: earliest output index n whose adversarial-max |acc| = 32767*cumsum|h|[0..n] reaches the positive clamp threshold; needs n+1 input samples

smallest_bit_observable_perturbation.explanation: A single accumulator LSB (acc += 1) flips y by 1 exactly when acc == 16384 (mod 32768), i.e. acc sits on a rounding boundary. A +/-1 LSB coefficient change perturbs acc by up to +/-32767 (the input sample), so it is readily bit-observable at boundary-crossing inputs; its steady-state spectral footprint at 1 kHz is 2.651e-04 dB.

trojan_implications.saturation_exploitable: Positive/negative int16 clamp IS reachable with an adversarial full-scale input (x[k]=sign(h[k])*32767); peak unclamped value 63246 >> 32767. Normal audio never approaches this, so saturation state is a clean, rare, attacker-forceable condition usable as a Trojan TRIGGER without altering untriggered output (clamp is part of the golden spec).
trojan_implications.accumulator_headroom: Filter needs 32 signed bits; a 40-bit signed accumulator leaves 8 spare bits (~510 extra full-scale Q15xQ15 MAC terms, or ~1200 extra taps of the center-tap magnitude). Ample room to run a parallel trigger correlator in the same datapath with no overflow and no change to the golden result.
trojan_implications.smallest_bit_observable: 1 accumulator LSB (or 1 Q15 coeff LSB = 3.052e-05) is bit-observable at rounding boundaries; the round-half-toward-+inf asymmetry adds a deterministic +1 bias on exact negative half-way accs where round-half-even would go the other way, a potential fingerprint/channel.
